prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Implement user creation OKTA/C#/.net Core
After I provide access to our gitlab repo you have to deliver a web method in our existing C# backend (running on node.js) which accepts a password and an email and with that invoke the OKTA api to create a new user in our OKTA auth account. I can provide help to get you up and running with the okta api details and how the code work, for the moment you won't need any database access. Also I can provide you a short demo about why and how I need this task to be done. The app is not in production yet.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web applications.

I can help you implement the user creation web method in your existing backend so it accepts an email and password, then calls the OKTA API to create a new user in your OKTA auth account. I’m comfortable working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, and full-stack backend integrations, and I’m used to stepping into existing codebases and getting up to speed quickly.

Since you can provide the OKTA details and a demo of the workflow, I can focus on building the endpoint cleanly and matching your existing code structure. I don’t need database access for this task, and I’m ready to work with your GitLab repo as soon as access is shared.
